is Cause Of

Property

The relation that obtains between two eventualities e and e' if and only if the occurrence of e contributes to make e' occur

Note

Multiple eventualities can entertain the relation loze:isCauseOf with a given eventuality, since an eventuality can have more than one cause

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
